name: Cilento and Vallo di Diano National Park with the Archeological Sites of Paestum and Velia, and the Certosa di Padula
description: In Italy's southern Campania region, this vast park of mountain ridges and coast takes in the ruins of two Greek-era cities, Paestum and Velia, and the Certosa di Padula monastery. Paestum is the highlight: three Doric temples from about 550–450 BCE still stand beside intact city walls and paved streets. The area once marked the frontier between Greek colonies and the Lucanian peoples inland.
